reviews.text_en:
The young female shop assistant was very professional and great.

Unfortunately, I forgot to ask her name. The shop wasn't big, but the selection was quite complete. They had fresh flowers and pre-rolled joints. And the varieties of cannabis flowers were all amazing! I was about to buy joints and leave, but the shop assistant suggested I buy fresh flowers. The price was the same, and she could grind and roll them into joints for me for free!

I chose the two varieties shown in the photo. I have to say, the 37% Gold Dust is truly incredible!

Of course, the other variety was also very good. The refrigerator next to the shop also had cannabis edibles. I highly recommend the gummies. Each one is 100mg and contains 5 pieces. Perfect for island hopping and New Year's Eve celebrations—two at a time!

I will definitely come back next time I'm in Phuket!

By a customer who bought from them on two consecutive days 🤣
